data.name: Naked Courage
data.description: At 3rd level, the savage barbarian gains a +%1 dodge bonus to AC and a +%1 morale bonus on saving throws against fear when wearing no armor (shields are allowed). This bonus increases by +1 for every six levels after 3rd. This ability replaces trap sense.|NakedCourageDodgeBonus
